settings.acceptance: the fit's value at the solver's own precision (60 digits) on the certifying grid, relative to F_0(x) at each node
settings.search: confirm the record's count with its own pair on the minimax route; if it misses, sweep every pair at that count and then search upward; if it meets, solve every pair at each count below on the full grid until none meets, and the Lawson route is run at a count only when the Remez route found no meeting fit and the negative answer has to be certified

resume.note: a reused cell was computed by the earlier script revision; the changes since are the completion print, this resume, and the upward direction of the search, none of which touches the arithmetic of a cell that completed

cells.minimality: every pair swept at each count below until one failed; that failing sweep is the below-count check rational_count applies
